import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type PointerEvent } from "react";
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import { expect, userEvent, waitFor, within } from "storybook/test";
import { Badge, Button, LinkButton, Switch } from "@creator-signal/ui";
import { referencePath } from "../../reference-path";
import "../../planned-helper.css";
import spoonflowerBackdrop from "../../../reference-assets/spoonflower-homepage.png";

const states = {
  ready: { label: "Ready for your next sync", detail: "Sales Pulse and Spoonflower connected", action: "Open Sales Pulse", destination: "Helper settings in Sales Pulse", tone: "success" },
  importing: { label: "Importing statements · 8 of 20", detail: "Statements phase · your work continues in the background", action: "View activity", destination: "Spoonflower Activity in Sales Pulse", tone: "info" },
  content: { label: "3 new statements imported", detail: "Saved in Sales Pulse · just now", action: "View statements", destination: "The three newly saved statements in Sales Pulse", tone: "success" },
  signIn: { label: "Sign in to Spoonflower", detail: "Sales Pulse connected · Spoonflower needs attention", action: "Open Spoonflower", destination: "Spoonflower sign-in; no sign-in occurs in this preview", tone: "warning" },
  waiting: { label: "Waiting for Spoonflower", detail: "Next retry in 2 minutes · sample timing", action: "View activity", destination: "The safe reason and next retry time for this action", tone: "warning" },
  offline: { label: "Helper connection lost", detail: "Last confirmed: importing · 2 minutes ago", action: "Check connection", destination: "Connection recovery guidance in Sales Pulse", tone: "error" },
  empty: { label: "Check complete · no new statements", detail: "Last checked just now", action: "View history", destination: "The completed check with zero newly saved records", tone: "neutral" }
} as const;
type Scenario = keyof typeof states;
type Position = { x: number; y: number };
const steps = ["Welcome", "Your connections", "Make it yours"];

function HelperWelcome({ firstVisit = true, scenario = "importing", popupInitiallyOpen = false, immersive = false }: { firstVisit?: boolean; scenario?: Scenario; popupInitiallyOpen?: boolean; immersive?: boolean }) {
  const dialog = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const replay = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const welcomeReturn = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const extensionToggle = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const [popupOpen, setPopupOpen] = useState(popupInitiallyOpen);
  const stage = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const toolbar = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const drag = useRef<{ pointer: number; x: number; y: number; start: Position } | null>(null);
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [backdropFailed, setBackdropFailed] = useState(false);
  const [visibility, setVisibility] = useState<"shown" | "tab" | "hidden">("shown");
  const [position, setPosition] = useState<Position | null>(null);
  const [menu, setMenu] = useState(false);
  const [destination, setDestination] = useState("");
  const [finished, setFinished] = useState(false);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Scenario>(scenario);
  const current = states[selected];
  useEffect(() => setSelected(scenario), [scenario]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = dialog.current;
    if (firstVisit && element && !element.open) element.showModal();
    return () => element?.close();
  }, [firstVisit]);

  const bounds = () => ({
    x: Math.max(0, (stage.current?.clientWidth ?? 0) - (toolbar.current?.offsetWidth ?? 0)),
    y: Math.max(0, (stage.current?.clientHeight ?? 0) - (toolbar.current?.offsetHeight ?? 0))
  });
  const clamp = (next: Position) => { const max = bounds(); return { x: Math.max(0, Math.min(next.x, max.x)), y: Math.max(0, Math.min(next.y, max.y)) }; };
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!stage.current || !toolbar.current) return;
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => setPosition(old => old ? clamp(old) : null));
    observer.observe(stage.current); observer.observe(toolbar.current);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [visibility]);
  const actualPosition = () => {
    const bar = toolbar.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    const page = stage.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { x: (bar?.left ?? 0) - (page?.left ?? 0) - (stage.current?.clientLeft ?? 0), y: (bar?.top ?? 0) - (page?.top ?? 0) - (stage.current?.clientTop ?? 0) };
  };
  const openWelcome = () => { welcomeReturn.current = null; setStep(0); dialog.current?.showModal(); setMenu(false); };
  const closeWelcome = () => dialog.current?.close();
  const dock = (value: string) => {
    const max = bounds();
    if (value === "bottom-centre") setPosition(null);
    else setPosition({ x: value.includes("left") ? 0 : max.x, y: value.includes("top") ? 0 : max.y });
  };
  const endDrag = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (!drag.current || drag.current.pointer !== event.pointerId) return;
    drag.current = null;
    if (event.currentTarget.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) event.currentTarget.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    setPosition(old => {
      if (!old) return old;
      const max = bounds();
      return clamp({ x: old.x < 24 ? 0 : max.x - old.x < 24 ? max.x : old.x, y: old.y < 24 ? 0 : max.y - old.y < 24 ? max.y : old.y });
    });
  };
  const hide = (mode: "tab" | "hidden") => { setVisibility(mode); setMenu(false); (immersive ? extensionToggle.current : replay.current)?.focus(); };
  const toolbarStyle: CSSProperties = position ? { left: position.x, top: position.y, bottom: "auto", transform: "none" } : {};
  const badgeTone = current.tone;

  return <main className={`cs-planned-helper${immersive ? " cs-ph-immersive" : ""}`}>
    {!immersive && <>
    <header className="cs-ph-reference">
      <div><Badge tone="warning">Planned · synthetic interactive preview</Badge><h1>Helper welcome & toolbar</h1><p>Try the welcome, hide and restore, or move the toolbar. No provider connection or import runs here.</p></div>
      <a href={referencePath("/?path=/story/dls-start-here-current-and-planned--overview")} target="_top">Current and planned</a>
    </header>
    <div className="cs-ph-controls" aria-label="Preview controls">
      <label>Sample status <select value={selected} onChange={event => { setSelected(event.target.value as Scenario); setDestination(""); }}>{Object.entries(states).map(([key, value]) => <option value={key} key={key}>{value.label}</option>)}</select></label>
      <button className="cs-ui-button cs-ui-button--secondary" ref={extensionToggle} aria-expanded={popupOpen} aria-controls="cs-ph-extension-popup" onClick={() => setPopupOpen(!popupOpen)}>Open extension popup</button>
      <button className="cs-ui-button cs-ui-button--secondary" ref={replay} onClick={openWelcome}>Replay welcome</button>
    </div>


    </>}
    <div className="cs-ph-page" ref={stage} aria-label="Spoonflower page preview">
      {immersive && <button className="cs-ui-button cs-ui-button--secondary cs-ph-extension-launcher" ref={extensionToggle} aria-expanded={popupOpen} aria-controls="cs-ph-extension-popup" onClick={() => setPopupOpen(!popupOpen)}>Open extension popup</button>}
      <img className="cs-ph-backdrop" src={spoonflowerBackdrop} alt="" hidden={backdropFailed} onError={() => setBackdropFailed(true)} />
      {backdropFailed && <p className="cs-ph-backdrop-fallback" role="status">Spoonflower screenshot unavailable. Helper controls are still available.</p>}
    {popupOpen && <section className="cs-ph-extension" id="cs-ph-extension-popup" aria-label="Extension popup">
      <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => { setPopupOpen(false); extensionToggle.current?.focus(); }}>Close extension popup</Button>
      <p className="cs-ph-eyebrow">BROWSER EXTENSION POPUP · PLANNED</p>
      <h2>Sales Pulse Helper</h2>
      <p>Open from the extension icon in your browser.</p>
      <p role="status">{visibility === "shown" ? "Helper is visible on this page." : "Helper is hidden on this page."}</p>
      <div className="cs-ph-extension-actions">
        <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => { setVisibility(visibility === "shown" ? "hidden" : "shown"); setMenu(false); }}>{visibility === "shown" ? "Hide Helper" : "Show Helper"}</Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" onClick={event => { openWelcome(); welcomeReturn.current = event.currentTarget; }}>Show welcome</Button>
      </div>
      <small>Hiding Helper does not stop background work. You can reopen the welcome at any time.</small>
    </section>}
      {destination && <p className="cs-ph-destination" role="status">Preview destination: {destination}. Nothing was opened or executed.</p>}
      {visibility === "tab" && <Button className="cs-ph-edge-tab" variant="secondary" onClick={() => setVisibility("shown")}>Helper · {current.label} · Show</Button>}
      {visibility === "shown" && <div className="cs-ph-toolbar" style={toolbarStyle} ref={toolbar} aria-label="Helper toolbar">
        <button className="cs-ph-grip" aria-label="Move toolbar" aria-describedby="cs-ph-move-help" onPointerDown={event => {
          if (event.button !== 0) return;
          event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
          drag.current = { pointer: event.pointerId, x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY, start: actualPosition() };
        }} onPointerMove={event => {
          const active = drag.current;
          if (active?.pointer === event.pointerId) setPosition(clamp({ x: active.start.x + event.clientX - active.x, y: active.start.y + event.clientY - active.y }));
        }} onPointerUp={endDrag} onPointerCancel={endDrag} onKeyDown={event => {
          const delta = { ArrowLeft: [-16, 0], ArrowRight: [16, 0], ArrowUp: [0, -16], ArrowDown: [0, 16] }[event.key];
          if (delta) { event.preventDefault(); const p = actualPosition(); setPosition(clamp({ x: p.x + delta[0]!, y: p.y + delta[1]! })); }
          if (event.key === "Home") { event.preventDefault(); setPosition(null); }
        }}><span aria-hidden="true">⠿</span></button>
        <img className="cs-ph-mark" src={referencePath("/brand-assets/delivery/sales-pulse-mark/light-background.svg")} alt="" width="32" height="32" onError={event => { event.currentTarget.hidden = true; }} />
        <div className="cs-ph-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"><strong>{current.label}</strong><small>{current.detail}</small>{selected === "importing" && <progress value="8" max="20" aria-label="Statements imported">8 of 20 statements</progress>}</div>
        {selected === "importing" || selected === "waiting" ? <LinkButton href="https://salespulse.creatorsignal.me/sales-pulse/spoonflower/activity" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="View activity (opens in a new tab)">View activity</LinkButton> : <Button onClick={() => setDestination(current.destination)}>{current.action}</Button>}
        <Button variant="ghost" aria-expanded={menu} aria-controls="cs-ph-toolbar-options" onClick={() => setMenu(!menu)}>Options</Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" aria-label="Hide toolbar" onClick={() => hide("tab")}>×</Button>
        {menu && <div className="cs-ph-options" id="cs-ph-toolbar-options"><p id="cs-ph-move-help">Drag the grip, or focus it and use arrow keys. Home resets position.</p><label><span className="cs-ph-sr">Position</span><select defaultValue="" onChange={event => dock(event.target.value)}><option value="" disabled>Choose position</option><option value="bottom-centre">Bottom centre</option><option value="bottom-left">Bottom left</option><option value="bottom-right">Bottom right</option><option value="top-left">Top left</option><option value="top-right">Top right</option></select></label><Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setPosition(null)}>Reset position</Button><Button variant="secondary" onClick={openWelcome}>Replay welcome</Button><Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => hide("hidden")}>Hide completely</Button><small>Hiding does not stop configured work. Restore with Show Helper in the extension popup.</small></div>}
        {!menu && <span id="cs-ph-move-help" className="cs-ph-sr">Drag to move. Use arrow keys when focused, or Home to reset. Position choices are in Options.</span>}
      </div>}
    </div>
    {!immersive && <footer className="cs-ph-boundary"><Badge tone={badgeTone}>{finished ? "Tour completed in this preview" : "Design proposal"}</Badge><p>Position and visibility survive changes within this preview only. Reload resets setup. The installed design would remember preferences and show onboarding once across tabs. Closing or finishing never starts an import.</p><a href={referencePath("/?path=/story/products-sales-pulse-helper--connected")} target="_top">Compare the current Helper popup</a> · <a href="https://github.com/creator-signal/sales-pulse/issues/1607">Design #1607</a></footer>}

    <dialog className="cs-ph-welcome" ref={dialog} aria-labelledby="cs-ph-welcome-title" aria-describedby="cs-ph-welcome-description" onClose={() => (welcomeReturn.current ?? (immersive ? extensionToggle.current : replay.current))?.focus()}>
      <div className="cs-ph-welcome-grid">
        <aside className="cs-ph-welcome-nav"><p className="cs-ph-eyebrow">SALES PULSE HELPER</p><h2 id="cs-ph-welcome-title">A helping hand<br /> for your shop.</h2><p id="cs-ph-welcome-description">Get connected. Stay informed.<br />Keep creating.</p><nav aria-label="Welcome steps">{steps.map((label, index) => <button key={label} aria-current={index === step ? "step" : undefined} onClick={() => setStep(index)}><span>{String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span>{label}</button>)}</nav><small>Planned experience · sample data</small></aside>
        <div className="cs-ph-welcome-main">
          <Button className="cs-ph-close" variant="ghost" aria-label="Close welcome" onClick={closeWelcome}>×</Button>

            {steps.map((label, panelStep) => <div key={label} className="cs-ph-welcome-panel" data-active={step === panelStep} aria-hidden={step !== panelStep} inert={step !== panelStep}>
          <div className="cs-ph-welcome-visual" aria-label="Illustrative Helper preview">

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Field, FieldLabel, Notice, Select, TextInput } from "@creator-signal/ui";
import {
  InstaticSpecimenStory,
  instaticProjection,
  useFilteredInstaticEntries
} from "../instatic/InstaticSpecimen";

function ImpactGalleryView() {
  const firstEntry = instaticProjection.entries[0];
  if (!firstEntry) throw new Error("Pinned Instatic projection is empty");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [source, setSource] = useState("all");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("all");
  const filtered = useFilteredInstaticEntries(query, source, category);
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState(firstEntry.id);
  const selected = filtered.find(({ id }) => id === selectedId) ?? filtered[0];
  const categories = useMemo(() => [...new Set(instaticProjection.entries.map((entry) => entry.category))].sort(), []);

  return (
    <main className="cs-story-shell" data-instatic-impact-gallery>
      <p className="cs-story-eyebrow">Consumers · generated catalogue projection · synthetic only</p>
      <h1 className="cs-story-title">Instatic Component Library impact gallery</h1>
      <p className="cs-story-lede">Search all {instaticProjection.summary.entryCount} pinned entries. Each result links to a separately generated stable story and previews the real Instatic specimen with current branch design-system assets.</p>
      <Notice heading="Review projection, not runtime authority" tone="info">
        <p>Instatic continues to own CMS fields, patterns, capabilities and HTML. <code>@creator-signal/ui</code> remains the React API authority. Provider-controlled output is labelled and never fabricated.</p>
      </Notice>
      <section className="cs-instatic-gallery-controls" aria-label="Filter the Instatic catalogue">
        <Field><FieldLabel htmlFor="instatic-gallery-query">Search entries</FieldLabel><TextInput id="instatic-gallery-query" type="search" value={query} onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.currentTarget.value)} /></Field>
        <Field><FieldLabel htmlFor="instatic-gallery-source">Source</FieldLabel><Select id="instatic-gallery-source" value={source} onChange={(event) => setSource(event.currentTarget.value)}><option value="all">All sources</option><option value="built-in">Instatic built-in</option><option value="plugin">Creator Signal plugin</option></Select></Field>
        <Field><FieldLabel htmlFor="instatic-gallery-category">Category</FieldLabel><Select id="instatic-gallery-category" value={category} onChange={(event) => setCategory(event.currentTarget.value)}><option value="all">All categories</option>{categories.map((value) => <option key={value} value={value}>{value}</option>)}</Select></Field>
      </section>
      <p role="status">Showing {filtered.length} of {instaticProjection.summary.entryCount} entries.</p>
      <section className="cs-instatic-gallery-layout">
        <ul className="cs-instatic-gallery-list" aria-label="Instatic catalogue entries">
          {filtered.map((entry) => <li key={entry.id}><button className="cs-instatic-gallery-entry" type="button" aria-current={selected?.id === entry.id ? "true" : undefined} onClick={() => setSelectedId(entry.id)}><strong>{entry.name}</strong><span>{entry.registryOrigin === "plugin" ? "Creator Signal plugin" : `Built-in · ${entry.category}`}</span><code>{entry.id}</code></button></li>)}
        </ul>
        {selected && selected.scenarios[0] ? <InstaticSpecimenStory embedded entryId={selected.id} scenarioId={selected.scenarios[0].id} /> : <Notice heading="No entries match" tone="warning"><p>Clear one or more filters to continue reviewing the pinned catalogue.</p></Notice>}
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

  title: "Consumers/Instatic Component Library",
  tags: ["autodocs"],
  parameters: { docs: { description: { component: "Searchable generated review projection for the complete pinned Instatic executable catalogue." } } }
} satisfies Meta;

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import { Badge, ResponsiveTable, Table, TableBody, TableCaption, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@creator-signal/ui";
import migration from "../../migration-status.json";

function tone(status: string): "neutral" | "success" | "warning" | "info" {
  if (status === "migrated") return "success";
  if (status === "in-progress") return "warning";
  if (status === "accepted-no-work") return "info";
  return "neutral";
}

function MigrationStatus() {
  return (
    <main className="cs-story-shell">
      <p className="cs-story-eyebrow">Epic #{migration.epic} projection</p>
      <h1 className="cs-story-title">Surface migration status</h1>
      <p className="cs-story-lede">{migration.authority}</p>
      <section className="cs-story-section">
        <ResponsiveTable aria-label="Design-system surface migration status">
          <Table className="cs-migration-table">
            <TableCaption>Current source-controlled Storybook projection for every later consumer in the canonical surface register.</TableCaption>
            <TableHead><TableRow><TableHeader scope="col">Surface</TableHeader><TableHeader scope="col">Status</TableHeader><TableHeader scope="col">Delivery issues</TableHeader></TableRow></TableHead>
            <TableBody>{migration.surfaces.map((surface) => <TableRow key={surface.id}><TableHeader scope="row">{surface.name}</TableHeader><TableCell><Badge tone={tone(surface.status)}>{surface.status}</Badge></TableCell><TableCell>{surface.issues.map((issue) => `#${issue}`).join(", ")}</TableCell></TableRow>)}</TableBody>
          </Table>
        </ResponsiveTable>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

const meta = { id: "governance-canonical-surface-register",
  title: "Migration status/Canonical surface register", component: MigrationStatus, tags: ["autodocs"] } satisfies Meta<typeof MigrationStatus>;
export default meta;
type Story = StoryObj<typeof meta>;
export const CurrentProjection: Story = {};

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { referencePath } from "../reference-path";
import {
  Badge,
  Button,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  CardDescription,
  CardHeader,
  CardTitle,
  Field,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldLabel,
  LinkButton,
  Notice,
  ResponsiveTable,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCaption,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
  TextInput
} from "@creator-signal/ui";
import { ThemeControl, useTheme } from "@creator-signal/ui/client";

function AdminFrame({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const { preference, resolvedTheme } = useTheme();
  return (
    <main className="cs-admin-preview" data-cs-theme={resolvedTheme} data-cs-theme-preference={preference}>
      <header className="cs-admin-preview__header">
        <div className="cs-admin-preview__identity">
          <img alt="Creator Signal" src={referencePath("/brand-assets/delivery/creator-signal-logo-horizontal/one-colour.svg")} />
          <div><strong>Sales Pulse Admin</strong><span>operator@example.test · synthetic reference</span></div>
        </div>
        <ThemeControl className="cs-admin-preview__theme" label="Appearance" />
        <Badge tone="success">Read-only session</Badge>
      </header>
      {children}
    </main>
  );
}

function OverviewPreview() {
  return (
    <AdminFrame>
      <section className="cs-admin-preview__heading" aria-labelledby="admin-preview-title">
        <div><p>Platform</p><h1 id="admin-preview-title">System readiness</h1><span>Independent, redacted evidence from approved operator sources.</span></div>
        <LinkButton href="#audit" variant="secondary">Review audit</LinkButton>
      </section>
      <section className="cs-ui-review-grid" aria-label="Service status">
        <Card><CardHeader><CardTitle>Sales Pulse read model</CardTitle><CardDescription>Restricted aggregate functions</CardDescription></CardHeader><CardContent><Badge tone="success">Available</Badge></CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardHeader><CardTitle>Stripe validation</CardTitle><CardDescription>Provider comparison only</CardDescription></CardHeader><CardContent><Badge tone="warning">Two warnings</Badge></CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardHeader><CardTitle>Helper release</CardTitle><CardDescription>Immutable five-browser evidence</CardDescription></CardHeader><CardContent><Badge tone="info">Evidence stale</Badge></CardContent></Card>
      </section>
      <ResponsiveTable aria-label="Synthetic deployment evidence">
        <Table>
          <TableCaption>Synthetic deployment evidence; no production data.</TableCaption>
          <TableHead><TableRow><TableHeader scope="col">Application</TableHeader><TableHeader scope="col">Source</TableHeader><TableHeader scope="col">State</TableHeader></TableRow></TableHead>
          <TableBody>
            <TableRow><TableHeader scope="row">Sales Pulse Admin</TableHeader><TableCell>example revision</TableCell><TableCell><Badge tone="success">Matching</Badge></TableCell></TableRow>
            <TableRow><TableHeader scope="row">Sales Pulse App</TableHeader><TableCell>example revision</TableCell><TableCell><Badge tone="warning">Convergence unknown</Badge></TableCell></TableRow>
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
      </ResponsiveTable>
    </AdminFrame>
  );
}

function GuardedMutationPreview() {
  return (
    <AdminFrame>
      <section className="cs-admin-preview__narrow" aria-labelledby="guarded-title">
        <h1 id="guarded-title">Suspend synthetic workspace</h1>
        <Notice heading="Sensitive action" tone="warning"><p>This requires a current operations unlock, audit reason and exact workspace confirmation.</p></Notice>
        <form className="cs-ui-review-form" onSubmit={(event) => event.preventDefault()}>
          <Field><FieldLabel htmlFor="admin-reason">Audit reason</FieldLabel><FieldDescription id="admin-reason-help">Recorded as restricted security evidence.</FieldDescription><TextInput aria-describedby="admin-reason-help" id="admin-reason" /></Field>
          <Field><FieldLabel htmlFor="admin-confirm">Type example-workspace-01 to confirm</FieldLabel><TextInput id="admin-confirm" /></Field>
          <div className="cs-ui-review-form-actions"><Button variant="danger">Suspend workspace</Button><Button variant="ghost">Cancel</Button></div>
        </form>
      </section>
    </AdminFrame>
  );
}

function PermissionPreview() {
  return <AdminFrame><section className="cs-admin-preview__narrow"><Notice heading="Owner permission required" tone="error"><p>Your operator session cannot manage administrator roles. No provider request was made.</p></Notice><LinkButton href="#dashboard" variant="secondary">Return to dashboard</LinkButton></section></AdminFrame>;
}

function UnavailablePreview() {
  return <AdminFrame><section className="cs-admin-preview__narrow"><Notice heading="Monitoring source unavailable" tone="warning"><p>Runtime status cannot be read. This does not prove that the service is down.</p></Notice><Button variant="secondary">Retry evidence</Button></section></AdminFrame>;
}

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import patternSource from "../../../../../design-system/patterns/source.json";
import "../../experiences.css";

type PatternEntry = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  outcome: string;
  owner: string;
  sourceKind: string;
  sourcePath: string;
  storyId: string;
  elements: string[];
  components: string[];
  widgets: string[];
  states: string[];
};

const registry = patternSource as { definition: string; patterns: PatternEntry[] };

function LayerList({ label, values }: { label: string; values: string[] }) {
  return <div><dt>{label}</dt><dd>{values.length ? values.map((value) => <code key={value}>{value}</code>) : <span>Not required</span>}</dd></div>;
}

function PatternOverview() {
  return (
    <main className="cs-dls-shell cs-patterns-reference">
      <header className="cs-components-hero">
        <p className="cs-dls-kicker">DLS · Patterns</p>
        <h1>Repeatable arrangements with real owners.</h1>
        <p>{registry.definition}</p>
        <dl className="cs-elements-counts"><div><dt>Governed Patterns</dt><dd>{registry.patterns.length}</dd></div><div><dt>Duplicate implementations</dt><dd>0</dd></div><div><dt>Issue</dt><dd>#1412</dd></div></dl>
      </header>
      <section aria-labelledby="pattern-inventory-title" className="cs-experience-inventory">
        <div className="cs-dls-section-heading"><div><p className="cs-dls-card-label">Owned inventory</p><h2 id="pattern-inventory-title">Start with the convention</h2></div><p>The DLS links to each existing source-controlled composition. The owning application still owns workflow and data behaviour.</p></div>
        <div className="cs-experience-card-grid">
          {registry.patterns.map((pattern) => <article data-pattern-id={pattern.id} key={pattern.id}>
            <p className="cs-component-kind">{pattern.sourceKind}</p>
            <h3><a href={`?path=/story/${pattern.storyId}`}>{pattern.label}</a></h3>
            <p>{pattern.outcome}</p>
            <dl><LayerList label="Elements" values={pattern.elements} /><LayerList label="Components" values={pattern.components} /><LayerList label="Widgets" values={pattern.widgets} /><LayerList label="States" values={pattern.states} /></dl>
            <footer><strong>Owner:</strong> {pattern.owner}<br /><code>{pattern.sourcePath}</code></footer>
          </article>)}
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import { AppI18nProvider } from "../../../web/i18n/client";
import { ProDashboardView } from "../../../web/app/sales-pulse/spoonflower/dashboard/pro/pro-dashboard-client";
import { PRO_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE } from "../../../web/app/sales-pulse/spoonflower/dashboard/pro/pro-dashboard.fixture";
import type { DashboardDataState } from "../../../web/app/sales-pulse/spoonflower/dashboard/_lib/dashboard-composition";
import type { DatePreset } from "../../../web/app/sales-pulse/spoonflower/dashboard-date-ranges";

function longLabelFixture() {
  return {
    ...PRO_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE,
    bestSellers: {
      ...PRO_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.bestSellers,
      items: [{
        ...PRO_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.bestSellers.items[0]!,
        designName: "A deliberately long synthetic design name for narrow layouts and two hundred percent browser zoom"
      }, ...PRO_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.bestSellers.items.slice(1)]
    },
    collections: {
      ...PRO_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.collections,
      items: [{
        ...PRO_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.collections.items[0]!,
        name: "A deliberately long synthetic collection name that remains readable without horizontal overflow"
      }, ...PRO_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.collections.items.slice(1)]
    }
  };
}

function ProDashboardPreview({ longLabels = false, state = "ready" }: { longLabels?: boolean; state?: DashboardDataState }) {
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<DatePreset>("ytd");
  const [customRange, setCustomRange] = useState({ from: "2026-01-01", to: "2026-04-30" });
  const data = state === "loading" || state === "error" ? null : longLabels ? longLabelFixture() : PRO_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE;
  return (
    <AppI18nProvider locale="en-AU">
      <ProDashboardView
        customRange={customRange}
        data={data}
        {...(state === "error" ? { errorMessage: "Synthetic Storybook error. No marketplace request was made." } : {})}
        onApplyCustomRange={() => undefined}
        onCustomRangeChange={setCustomRange}
        onPeriodChange={setPeriod}
        onRetry={() => undefined}
        period={period}
        state={state}
      />
    </AppI18nProvider>
  );
}

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import { expect, userEvent, within } from "storybook/test";
import { referencePath } from "../reference-path";
import {
  Badge,
  Button,
  Card,
  Checkbox,
  EmptyState,
  ErrorState,
  Field,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldLabel,
  FormStatus,
  KeyValueItem,
  KeyValueList,
  Notice,
  Panel,
  ResponsiveTable,
  Select,
  Stat,
  StatGroup,
  StatusIndicator,
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCaption,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
  TextInput
} from "@creator-signal/ui";
import { Dialog } from "@creator-signal/ui/client";

function PatternShell({ children, title, purpose }: { children: React.ReactNode; title: string; purpose: string }) {
  return (
    <main className="cs-story-shell">
      <p className="cs-story-eyebrow">Reusable pattern · synthetic content</p>
      <h1 className="cs-story-title">{title}</h1>
      <p className="cs-story-lede">{purpose}</p>
      <section className="cs-story-section">{children}</section>
    </main>
  );
}

function FormAndAuthentication() {
  return (
    <PatternShell title="Forms and authentication" purpose="Labels, descriptions, validation, status and primary/secondary actions preserve a predictable reading and focus order.">
      <Panel>
        <form className="cs-ui-review-form" onSubmit={(event) => event.preventDefault()}>
          <Field>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor="pattern-email">Email address</FieldLabel>
            <FieldDescription id="pattern-email-help">Use the address connected to your Creator Signal workspace.</FieldDescription>
            <TextInput autoComplete="email" id="pattern-email" aria-describedby="pattern-email-help" defaultValue="maya@example.test" />
          </Field>
          <Field>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor="pattern-code">Verification code</FieldLabel>
            <TextInput autoComplete="one-time-code" id="pattern-code" inputMode="numeric" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="pattern-code-error" />
            <FieldError id="pattern-code-error">Enter the six-digit code. No account changes were made.</FieldError>
          </Field>
          <Checkbox label="Trust this browser for 30 days" description="Do not use this option on a shared device." />
          <FormStatus tone="info">A new code can be requested in 24 seconds.</FormStatus>
          <div className="cs-ui-review-form-actions"><Button type="submit">Verify</Button><Button variant="ghost">Use another account</Button></div>
        </form>
      </Panel>
    </PatternShell>
  );
}

function NavigationHeader() {
  return (
    <PatternShell title="Navigation and header" purpose="Identity, location and high-value actions remain distinct at desktop, mobile and extension widths.">
      <header className="cs-product-preview__header">
        <span className="cs-product-preview__brand"><img alt="Sales Pulse by Creator Signal" src={referencePath("/brand-assets/delivery/sales-pulse-by-creator-signal-horizontal/light-background.svg")} /></span>
        <nav aria-label="Primary"><Button variant="ghost">Overview</Button><Button variant="ghost">Reports</Button><Button variant="ghost">Account</Button></nav>
        <Button>Import statement</Button>
      </header>
    </PatternShell>
  );
}

function StateFlows() {
  return (
    <PatternShell title="Loading, empty and outcome flows" purpose="Every state explains what happened, what remained safe and what the user can do next.">
      <h2>State examples</h2>
      <div className="cs-reference-grid">
        <EmptyState title="No reports yet" description="Create a report to see useful creator signals." actions={<Button>Create report</Button>} />
        <ErrorState title="Reports could not load" description="Your saved reports are safe." retry={<Button variant="secondary">Try again</Button>} />
        <Notice heading="Import complete" tone="success"><p>135 synthetic rows are ready to review.</p></Notice>
        <Notice heading="Review needed" tone="warning"><p>Two rows need a product category.</p></Notice>
      </div>
    </PatternShell>
  );
}

function ConfirmationAndDestructive() {
  return (
    <PatternShell title="Confirmation and destructive action" purpose="The trigger is explicit, consequences are described before confirmation and keyboard focus returns safely.">
      <Dialog
        title="Disconnect this synthetic shop?"
        trigger="Disconnect shop"
        description="New marketplace imports will stop. Existing reports remain available."
        actions={<><Button variant="ghost">Keep connected</Button><Button variant="danger">Disconnect</Button></>}
      >
        <KeyValueList><KeyValueItem label="Shop" value="Aster Studio" /><KeyValueItem label="Last import" value="Today at 09:42" /></KeyValueList>
      </Dialog>
    </PatternShell>
  );
}

function AccountPlanBilling() {
  return (
    <PatternShell title="Account, plan and billing states" purpose="Entitlements and payment failures use direct language and never rely on colour alone.">
      <div className="cs-reference-grid">
        <Card><Badge tone="info">Starter</Badge><h2>Current plan</h2><p>Shop Overview and monthly imports are available.</p><Button variant="secondary">Compare plans</Button></Card>
        <Notice heading="Payment method needs attention" tone="error"><p>Your existing access continues through 22 August. Update the payment method to prevent interruption.</p><Button>Update payment method</Button></Notice>
        <Notice heading="Pro feature" tone="warning"><p>Product recommendations require Pro. Your current reports are unchanged.</p><Button variant="secondary">Review Pro</Button></Notice>
      </div>
    </PatternShell>
  );
}

function AnalyticsAndRecommendation() {
  return (
    <PatternShell title="Analytics and explainable recommendations" purpose="Data keeps captions and scoped headers; recommendations state evidence and the proposed next action.">
      <StatGroup><Stat label="Net revenue" value="$4,820" context="Synthetic, last 30 days" /><Stat label="Repeat customers" value="31" context="Up 8%" /></StatGroup>
      <ResponsiveTable aria-label="Synthetic design performance">
        <Table><TableCaption>Synthetic design performance</TableCaption><TableHead><TableRow><TableHeader scope="col">Design</TableHeader><TableHeader scope="col">Signal</TableHeader><TableHeader scope="col">Revenue</TableHeader></TableRow></TableHead><TableBody><TableRow><TableHeader scope="row">Blue fern</TableHeader><TableCell><StatusIndicator tone="success">Growing</StatusIndicator></TableCell><TableCell>$1,240</TableCell></TableRow></TableBody></Table>
      </ResponsiveTable>
      <Notice heading="Consider featuring Blue fern" tone="info"><p>Its synthetic repeat-customer revenue grew across the last two reporting periods. Review the underlying orders before acting.</p><Button variant="secondary">See the evidence</Button></Notice>
    </PatternShell>
  );
}

    const canvas = within(canvasElement);

    await userEvent.click(trigger);
    await expect(canvas.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Disconnect this synthetic shop?" })).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent.click(canvas.getByRole("button", { name: "Close dialog" }));
    await expect(trigger).toHaveFocus();
  }
};
export const AccountPlanBillingStates: Story = { render: () => <AccountPlanBilling /> };
export const DataTableAnalyticsRecommendation: Story = { render: () => <AnalyticsAndRecommendation /> };

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import {
  typographyFamilies,
  typographyRoles,
  typographySourceVersion
} from "@creator-signal/design-system";

const roleExamples = [
  ["display", "Make clearer decisions from your marketplace data."],
  ["heading1", "Sales Pulse by Creator Signal"],
  ["heading2", "What changed this month"],
  ["heading3", "Strong signals worth acting on"],
  ["bodyLarge", "Creator Signal turns marketplace activity into practical, explainable recommendations for creators."],
  ["body", "Your dashboard compares sales, products and repeat-customer behaviour without asking you to interpret raw marketplace exports."],
  ["bodySmall", "Updated 10 August 2026 · Melbourne time"],
  ["label", "Reporting period"],
  ["control", "Last 30 days"],
  ["data", "A$4,280.60 · 18.4% · 1,204 orders"],
  ["dataLarge", "A$12,480.60"]
] as const;

const weightExamples = {
  fredoka: [500, 600, 700],
  mulish: [400, 500, 600, 700],
  caveat: [600]
} as const;

function RoleSpecimens({ fallback = false }: { fallback?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <main className="cs-story-shell" data-cs-fonts={fallback ? "fallback" : undefined}>
      <p className="cs-story-eyebrow">Typography · source v{typographySourceVersion}</p>
      <h1 className="cs-story-title">Creator Signal typography</h1>
      <p className="cs-story-lede">
        Fredoka carries display and headings, Mulish carries essential interface and data content, and Caveat is reserved for rare non-essential decoration. The font files are self-hosted build assets; no browser font CDN is part of this contract.
      </p>

      {fallback ? (
        <p className="cs-type-fallback-note" role="note">
          <strong>Fallback review:</strong> custom family references are deliberately disabled on this example. Content, hierarchy and numeric meaning must remain readable with the governed system stacks.
        </p>
      ) : null}

      <section className="cs-story-section" aria-labelledby="roles-heading">
        <p className="cs-story-eyebrow">Role contract</p>
        <h2 id="roles-heading">Typography roles in context</h2>
        <div className="cs-type-review-grid">
          {roleExamples.map(([roleName, copy]) => {
            const role = typographyRoles[roleName];
            return (
              <article className="cs-type-review-card" key={roleName}>
                <div className="cs-type-meta">
                  <code>{roleName}</code>
                  <span>{role.family}</span>
                  <span>{role.fontWeight}</span>
                  <span>{role.fontSize}</span>
                </div>
                <div className={`cs-type-${roleName.replace(/[A-Z]/g, (match) => `-${match.toLowerCase()}`)}`}>
                  {copy}
                </div>
              </article>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="cs-story-section" aria-labelledby="families-heading">
        <p className="cs-story-eyebrow">Family and weight boundaries</p>
        <h2 id="families-heading">Only the weights we actually use</h2>
        <div className="cs-type-review-grid">
          {(Object.keys(weightExamples) as Array<keyof typeof weightExamples>).map((familyName) => {
            const family = typographyFamilies[familyName];
            return (
              <article className="cs-type-review-card" key={familyName}>
                <div className="cs-type-meta">
                  <strong>{family.cssFamily}</strong>
                  <span>{family.purpose}</span>
                  <span>{family.weightRange[0]}–{family.weightRange[1]} available</span>
                </div>
                <div className="cs-type-family-specimen" style={{ fontFamily: `var(--cs-font-family-${familyName})` }}>
                  {weightExamples[familyName].map((weight) => (
                    <div className="cs-type-weight-row" key={weight}>
                      <code>{weight}</code>
                      <span style={{ fontWeight: weight }}>Creators deserve evidence they can act on.</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </article>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="cs-story-section" aria-labelledby="data-heading">
        <p className="cs-story-eyebrow">Operational and financial data</p>
        <h2 id="data-heading">Mulish keeps dense information stable</h2>
        <div className="cs-type-review-card" style={{ overflowX: "auto" }}>
          <table className="cs-type-data-table">
            <caption className="cs-type-body-small" style={{ textAlign: "left", marginBottom: "var(--cs-spacing-3)" }}>
              Synthetic Sales Pulse data for typography review only.
            </caption>
            <thead>
              <tr><th>Design</th><th>Revenue</th><th>Orders</th><th>Change</th></tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr><td>Botanical block print</td><td>A$2,840.50</td><td>128</td><td>+18.4%</td></tr>
              <tr><td>French pinstripe</td><td>A$1,906.20</td><td>93</td><td>+6.8%</td></tr>
              <tr><td>Textured plaid</td><td>A$986.40</td><td>47</td><td>−2.1%</td></tr>
            </tbody>

      <section className="cs-story-section" aria-labelledby="long-copy-heading">
        <p className="cs-story-eyebrow">Essential long-form copy</p>
        <h2 id="long-copy-heading">Errors, support and legal text stay calm and readable</h2>
        <div className="cs-type-review-grid">
          <article className="cs-type-review-card">
            <p className="cs-type-label">Error</p>
            <p className="cs-type-body">We couldn’t save this change. Your existing data is unchanged. Try again, or contact support if the problem continues.</p>
          </article>
          <article className="cs-type-review-card">
            <p className="cs-type-label">Support</p>
            <p className="cs-type-body">Need help understanding a recommendation? Open the explanation first, then contact support if the underlying marketplace data still doesn’t look right.</p>
          </article>
          <article className="cs-type-review-card">
            <p className="cs-type-label">Legal</p>
            <p className="cs-type-body-small">Creator Signal provides marketplace intelligence and explainable recommendations to support creator decisions. Recommendations are informational and do not guarantee marketplace performance or future sales.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="cs-story-section" aria-labelledby="decorative-heading">
        <p className="cs-story-eyebrow">Decorative exception</p>
        <h2 id="decorative-heading">Caveat never carries essential meaning</h2>
        <div className="cs-type-review-card">
          <p>Everything a user needs to understand is present in this Mulish sentence.</p>
          <span className="cs-type-decorative-sample" aria-hidden="true">a little extra flourish</span>
          <p className="cs-story-muted">The Caveat sample is hidden from assistive technology because it adds no information.</p>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

import { useState } from "react";
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import { AppI18nProvider } from "../../../web/i18n/client";
import {
  SALES_INSIGHT_ORDER,
  SalesDashboardView,
  type SalesAccent,
  type SalesDashboardData,
  type SalesDashboardFilters,
  type SalesLayout,
  type SalesSort
} from "../../../web/app/sales-pulse/spoonflower/dashboard/sales/sales-dashboard-view";
import { SALES_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE } from "../../../web/app/sales-pulse/spoonflower/dashboard/sales/sales-dashboard.fixture";
import type { DashboardDataState } from "../../../web/app/sales-pulse/spoonflower/dashboard/_lib/dashboard-composition";
import type { DatePreset } from "../../../web/app/sales-pulse/spoonflower/dashboard-date-ranges";

const initialFilters: SalesDashboardFilters = {
  from: "2026-01-01",
  to: "2026-04-30",
  category: "",
  format: "",
  material: "",
  search: "",
  repeatCategory: "",
  trendPeriod: "month",
  bestSellersLimit: 10,
  salesLimit: 10,
  repeatCustomersLimit: 10,
  salesSort: "date",
  salesDirection: "desc"
};

function fixtureFor({ imageFallback, limited, longLabels }: { imageFallback: boolean; limited: boolean; longLabels: boolean }): SalesDashboardData {
  const first = SALES_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.bestSellers.items[0]!;
  return {
    ...SALES_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE,
    access: limited ? {
      ...SALES_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.access,
      mode: "limited",
      searchAllowed: false,
      sortAllowed: false,
      paginationAllowed: false,
      mediaVisible: false,
      exportAllowed: false
    } : SALES_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.access,
    bestSellers: {
      ...SALES_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.bestSellers,
      items: [{
        ...first,
        designName: longLabels
          ? "A deliberately long synthetic design name that remains readable at narrow widths and two hundred percent browser zoom"
          : first.designName,
        thumbnailUrl: imageFallback ? null : first.thumbnailUrl
      }, ...SALES_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.bestSellers.items.slice(1)]
    },
    repeatCustomers: {
      ...SALES_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.repeatCustomers,
      items: SALES_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.repeatCustomers.items.map((customer, index) => index === 0 && longLabels
        ? { ...customer, customer: "A deliberately long synthetic customer identity used only to test wrapping and narrow layouts" }
        : customer)
    },
    trends: {
      ...SALES_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.trends,
      rising: SALES_DASHBOARD_FIXTURE.trends.rising.map((item) => ({ ...item, thumbnailUrl: imageFallback ? null : item.thumbnailUrl }))
    }
  };
}

function SalesDashboardPreview({
  imageFallback = false,
  limited = false,
  longLabels = false,
  state = "ready"
}: {
  imageFallback?: boolean;
  limited?: boolean;
  longLabels?: boolean;
  state?: DashboardDataState;
}) {
  const [accent, setAccent] = useState<SalesAccent>("default");
  const [layout, setLayout] = useState<SalesLayout>("visual");
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<DatePreset>("ytd");
  const [customRange, setCustomRange] = useState({ from: "2026-01-01", to: "2026-04-30" });
  const [filters, setFilters] = useState(initialFilters);
  const [enabledInsights, setEnabledInsights] = useState([...SALES_INSIGHT_ORDER]);
  const data = state === "loading" || state === "error" ? null : fixtureFor({ imageFallback, limited, longLabels });

  return (
    <AppI18nProvider locale="en-AU">
      <SalesDashboardView
        accent={accent}
        customRange={customRange}
        data={data}
        datePreset={period}
        enabledInsights={enabledInsights}
        {...(state === "error" ? { errorMessage: "Synthetic Storybook error. No marketplace request was made." } : {})}
        filters={filters}
        layout={layout}
        onAccentChange={setAccent}
        onApplyCustomRange={() => setFilters((current) => ({ ...current, ...customRange }))}
        onClearData={() => undefined}
        onCustomRangeChange={setCustomRange}
        onFilterChange={(name, value) => setFilters((current) => ({ ...current, [name]: value }))}
        onImportBackup={() => undefined}
        onLayoutChange={setLayout}
        onPeriodChange={setPeriod}
        onRemoveThumbnail={() => undefined}
        onResetFilters={() => setFilters(initialFilters)}
        onRetry={() => undefined}
        onShowUpgrade={() => undefined}
        onSortSales={(column: SalesSort) => setFilters((current) => ({ ...current, salesSort: column }))}
        onToggleInsight={(insight) => setEnabledInsights((current) => current.includes(insight) ? current.filter((value) => value !== insight) : [...current, insight])}
        onUploadThumbnail={() => undefined}
        state={state}
      />
    </AppI18nProvider>
  );
}

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import { Badge, KeyValueItem, KeyValueList, Notice, Panel } from "@creator-signal/ui";
import { ThemeControl, useTheme } from "@creator-signal/ui/client";
import { referencePath } from "../reference-path";

type HelperState = "signed-out" | "connected" | "connection-required" | "managed-update" | "provider-unavailable" | "capability-unavailable";

const stateContent: Record<HelperState, {
  notice: { heading: string; text: string; tone: "error" | "info" | "success" | "warning" };
  pulse: { label: string; tone: "error" | "success" | "warning" };
  spoonflower: { label: string; tone: "error" | "success" | "warning" };
  status: string;
}> = {
  "signed-out": {
    notice: { heading: "Sign in to Sales Pulse", text: "The installed popup shows Sales Pulse signed out and Spoonflower unavailable, as in the supplied reference.", tone: "warning" },
    pulse: { label: "Signed out", tone: "error" },
    spoonflower: { label: "Unavailable", tone: "error" },
    status: "Sign in to Sales Pulse."
  },
  connected: {
    notice: { heading: "Helper ready", text: "Both required sessions are available. No import or catalogue action starts from this reference.", tone: "success" },
    pulse: { label: "Connected", tone: "success" },
    spoonflower: { label: "Connected", tone: "success" },
    status: "Ready for a managed action"
  },
  "connection-required": {
    notice: { heading: "Connect both services", text: "Open Sales Pulse and Spoonflower, then check the connections again.", tone: "warning" },
    pulse: { label: "Sign in", tone: "warning" },
    spoonflower: { label: "Open Spoonflower", tone: "warning" },
    status: "Waiting for required sessions"
  },
  "managed-update": {
    notice: { heading: "Managed update in progress", text: "The Helper is processing a synthetic server-authorised catalogue action.", tone: "info" },
    pulse: { label: "Connected", tone: "success" },
    spoonflower: { label: "Connected", tone: "success" },
    status: "Step 3 of 5 · reading catalogue pages"
  },
  "provider-unavailable": {
    notice: { heading: "Spoonflower is not responding", text: "The managed action is paused. Nothing is discarded; retry after the provider recovers.", tone: "error" },
    pulse: { label: "Connected", tone: "success" },
    spoonflower: { label: "Unavailable", tone: "error" },
    status: "Paused safely · retry available"
  },
  "capability-unavailable": {
    notice: { heading: "Signed capability unavailable", text: "No Spoonflower request starts. Return to Sales Pulse, restore the signed operation bundle, then retry.", tone: "error" },
    pulse: { label: "Connected", tone: "success" },
    spoonflower: { label: "Unavailable", tone: "error" },
    status: "Sales Pulse could not load the Spoonflower capability"
  }
};

function Connection({ label, name, tone }: { label: string; name: string; tone: "error" | "success" | "warning" }) {
  return (
    <button className="cs-helper-connection" type="button">
      <span aria-hidden="true" className={`cs-helper-connection__icon cs-helper-connection__icon--${tone}`}>{tone === "success" ? "✓" : "!"}</span>
      <span><strong>{name}</strong><small>{label}</small></span>
    </button>
  );
}

function SalesPulseHelperReference({ state }: { state: HelperState }) {
  const content = stateContent[state];
  const { resolvedTheme } = useTheme();
  return (
    <main className="cs-story-shell" data-product-reference="sales-pulse-helper" data-helper-state={state}>
      <p className="cs-story-eyebrow">Product consumer · browser extension · synthetic only</p>
      <h1 className="cs-story-title">Sales Pulse Helper</h1>
      <p className="cs-story-lede">A dedicated reference for the fixed 400px-wide, square-corner browser popup, with content-driven height up to 600px. The packaged extension owns its plain-HTML composition, sessions and signed managed actions; Storybook renders no extension API or provider request.</p>

      <section className="cs-story-section cs-product-preview cs-product-preview__extension cs-helper-reference" aria-label={`Sales Pulse Helper ${state.replaceAll("-", " ")} reference`}>
        <header className="cs-product-preview__header cs-helper-reference__header">
          <span className="cs-product-preview__brand cs-helper-reference__brand">
            <img alt="" src={referencePath(`/brand-assets/delivery/sales-pulse-mark/${resolvedTheme === "dark" ? "dark" : "light"}-background.svg`)} />
            <span><strong>Sales Pulse Helper</strong><small>Creator Signal · preview build</small></span>
          </span>
          <ThemeControl label="Appearance" variant="icon" />
        </header>
        <div className="cs-product-preview__body">
          <div className="cs-helper-connections">
            <Connection label={content.pulse.label} name="Sales Pulse" tone={content.pulse.tone} />
            <Connection label={content.spoonflower.label} name="Spoonflower" tone={content.spoonflower.tone} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className={`cs-product-preview__footer cs-helper-status cs-helper-status--${content.notice.tone}`} role="status"><span aria-hidden="true" className="cs-helper-status__dot" />{content.status}</div>
      </section>

      <Notice heading={content.notice.heading} tone={content.notice.tone}><p>{content.notice.text}</p></Notice>
      <section className="cs-story-section cs-reference-grid" aria-label="Sales Pulse Helper reference boundary">
        <Panel className="cs-reference-card">
          <Badge tone="info">Consumer-owned runtime</Badge>
          <KeyValueList>
            <KeyValueItem label="Owner" value="Sales Pulse Helper" />
            <KeyValueItem label="Runtime source" value={<code>apps/browser-extension/src</code>} />
            <KeyValueItem label="Shared foundation" value="Governed tokens, typography, theme runtime and brand assets" />
            <KeyValueItem label="Acceptance" value={<code>pnpm browser-extension:acceptance:visual</code>} />
          </KeyValueList>
        </Panel>
        <Notice heading="Reference boundary" tone="info"><p>This projection documents the recognisable product surface and its states. The installed extension, signed operations and real browser sessions remain separately built and accepted.</p></Notice>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import { Badge } from "@creator-signal/ui";
import languageSystem from "../../../../../design-system/language-system.json";
import { referencePath } from "../../reference-path";

function statusTone(status: string): "success" | "warning" {
  return status === "source-integrated" ? "success" : "warning";
}

function StartHere() {
  const integrated = languageSystem.sections.filter(({ status }) => status === "source-integrated").length;

  return (
    <main className="cs-dls-shell">
      <section className="cs-dls-hero" aria-labelledby="dls-title">
        <div className="cs-dls-hero-copy">
          <p className="cs-dls-kicker">Creator Signal · Design Language System</p>
          <h1 id="dls-title">One language from brand intent to working experience.</h1>
          <p className="cs-dls-intro">{languageSystem.definition}</p>
          <p><a href={referencePath("/?path=/story/dls-start-here-current-and-planned--overview")} target="_top">Browse current and planned designs</a> — existing references and clearly labelled interactive proposals in one place.</p>
          <div className="cs-dls-summary" aria-label="DLS delivery status">
            <span><strong>{languageSystem.sections.length}</strong> core sections</span>
            <span><strong>{integrated}</strong> source-integrated</span>
            <span><strong>#{languageSystem.epic}</strong> programme authority</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <aside className="cs-dls-callout" aria-labelledby="source-of-truth-title">
          <p className="cs-dls-card-label">Source of truth</p>
          <h2 id="source-of-truth-title">Storybook explains the system. Owned packages implement it.</h2>
          <p>The reference is executable documentation with synthetic examples. Product and provider runtimes never import it.</p>
          <dl>
            <div><dt>Design</dt><dd>Brand intent and visual decisions</dd></div>
            <div><dt>Language</dt><dd>Shared names for elements and options</dd></div>
            <div><dt>System</dt><dd>Owned implementation and behaviour</dd></div>
          </dl>
        </aside>
      </section>

      <section className="cs-dls-section" aria-labelledby="audience-title">
        <div className="cs-dls-section-heading">
          <div>
            <p className="cs-dls-card-label">Choose your route</p>
            <h2 id="audience-title">Start with what you need to decide</h2>
          </div>
          <p>The same authority is presented for three disciplines, so hand-offs retain meaning.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="cs-dls-audience-grid">
          {languageSystem.audiences.map((audience, index) => (
            <article className="cs-dls-audience-card" key={audience.id}>
              <span className="cs-dls-index" aria-hidden="true">0{index + 1}</span>
              <h3>{audience.label}</h3>
              <p>{audience.description}</p>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="cs-dls-section" aria-labelledby="vocabulary-title">
        <div className="cs-dls-section-heading">
          <div>
            <p className="cs-dls-card-label">Shared vocabulary</p>
            <h2 id="vocabulary-title">Name the level before choosing the solution</h2>
          </div>
          <p>These terms are discrete. A consumer projection cannot become a core element, component or widget by appearing in Storybook.</p>
        </div>
        <ol className="cs-dls-language-flow">
          {languageSystem.taxonomy.map((entry) => (
            <li key={entry.id}>
              <div className="cs-dls-language-name"><strong>{entry.label}</strong><span>{entry.owner}</span></div>
              <p>{entry.description}</p>
              <small>Delivery issue #{entry.issue}</small>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>
      </section>

      <section className="cs-dls-section" aria-labelledby="map-title">
        <div className="cs-dls-section-heading">
          <div>
            <p className="cs-dls-card-label">System map</p>
            <h2 id="map-title">A complete DLS, with honest delivery status</h2>
          </div>
          <p>Pending means the section has an owner and authority path, but it does not yet claim complete reference coverage.</p>
        </div>
        <div className="cs-dls-map">
          {languageSystem.sections.map((section) => (
            <article className="cs-dls-map-card" key={section.id}>
              <div className="cs-dls-map-topline">
                <h3>{section.label}</h3>
                <Badge tone={statusTone(section.status)}>{section.status === "source-integrated" ? "Integrated" : "Pending"}</Badge>
              </div>
              <p>{section.description}</p>
              <footer><span>#{section.issue}</span><code>{section.id}</code></footer>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className="cs-dls-boundary" aria-labelledby="boundary-title">
        <div>
          <p className="cs-dls-card-label">Reference boundary</p>
          <h2 id="boundary-title">What belongs here—and what does not</h2>
        </div>
        <div className="cs-dls-boundary-grid">
          <div><strong>Core DLS</strong><p>Principles, foundations, elements, components, widgets, patterns, experiences, content and guidelines.</p></div>
          <div><strong>Supporting evidence</strong><p>Consumer and governance projections stay visible for review but cannot satisfy core DLS coverage.</p></div>
          <div><strong>Runtime ownership</strong><p>Packages own reusable implementation. Applications and provider adapters own complete workflow composition.</p></div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

import * as React from "react";
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import { ThemeControl, ThemeProvider, useTheme } from "@creator-signal/ui/client";
import {
  THEME_STORAGE_KEY,
  createThemeRuntime,
  resolveTheme,
  type ThemePreference
} from "@creator-signal/design-system/theme-runtime";

function createMemoryStorage(initialPreference: ThemePreference) {
  const values = new Map<string, string>();
  if (initialPreference !== "system") values.set(THEME_STORAGE_KEY, initialPreference);
  return {
    getItem(key: string) { return values.get(key) ?? null; },
    setItem(key: string, value: string) { values.set(key, value); },
    removeItem(key: string) { values.delete(key); }
  };
}

      <section className="cs-story-section" aria-labelledby="runtime-heading">

function ThemeReviewSurface() {
  const { preference, resolvedTheme } = useTheme();
  return (
    <div className="cs-story-root" data-cs-theme={resolvedTheme} data-cs-theme-preference={preference}>
      <ThemePanel />
    </div>
  );
}

function ThemeRuntimeReview({ initialPreference }: { initialPreference: ThemePreference }) {
  const createRuntime = React.useCallback(() => {
    const media = typeof window.matchMedia === "function" ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)") : undefined;
    return createThemeRuntime({
      root: document.documentElement,
      storage: createMemoryStorage(initialPreference),
      ...(media ? { media } : {})
    });
  }, [initialPreference]);

  const initialSnapshot = React.useMemo(() => {
    const systemDark = typeof window.matchMedia === "function"
      ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches
      : false;
    return { preference: initialPreference, resolvedTheme: resolveTheme(initialPreference, systemDark) } as const;
  }, [initialPreference]);

  return (
    <ThemeProvider createRuntime={createRuntime} initialSnapshot={initialSnapshot}>
      <ThemeReviewSurface />
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}

  id: "dls-foundations-theme-runtime",

    docs: {
      description: {
        component: "Executable review of the real #878 framework-neutral runtime and narrow React bindings. System follows the browser/OS preference; Light and Dark prove explicit overrides."
      }
    }
  },
  argTypes: {
    initialPreference: {
      control: "select",
      options: ["system", "light", "dark"]
    }
  }
} satisfies Meta<typeof ThemeRuntimeReview>;

export const Light: Story = { args: { initialPreference: "light" }, globals: { theme: "light" } };

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import componentSource from "@creator-signal/ui/components.json";
import widgetSource from "@creator-signal/ui/widgets.json";

type Classification = "component" | "widget" | "subcomponent" | "runtime-utility";
type Concept = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  summary: string;
  storyId: string;
  exports: Array<{ name: string; classification: Classification; role: string }>;
};
type OfferedWidget = { conceptId: string };
type AuditEntry = { id: string; label: string; disposition: string; reason: string; alternative: string; issue?: number };

const components = componentSource as { concepts: Concept[] };
const registry = widgetSource as { definition: string; offered: OfferedWidget[]; audit: AuditEntry[] };
const conceptById = new Map(components.concepts.map((entry) => [entry.id, entry]));
const offered = registry.offered.map(({ conceptId }) => conceptById.get(conceptId)!);

function WidgetCatalogue() {
  const publicApis = offered.flatMap((concept) => concept.exports);
  return (
    <main className="cs-dls-shell cs-widgets-reference">
      <header className="cs-components-hero">
        <p className="cs-dls-kicker">DLS · Widgets</p>
        <h1>Interactive tasks with owned behaviour.</h1>
        <p>{registry.definition}</p>
        <dl className="cs-elements-counts"><div><dt>Offered Widgets</dt><dd>{offered.length}</dd></div><div><dt>Public APIs</dt><dd>{publicApis.length}</dd></div><div><dt>Expected names audited</dt><dd>{registry.audit.length}</dd></div><div><dt>Fake specimens</dt><dd>0</dd></div></dl>
      </header>

      <section className="cs-components-inventory" aria-labelledby="widget-inventory-title">
        <div className="cs-dls-section-heading"><div><p className="cs-dls-card-label">Owned inventory</p><h2 id="widget-inventory-title">Start with the task and behaviour</h2></div><p>Every offered page renders the real package and exercises its supported keyboard and state transitions.</p></div>
        <div className="cs-components-grid cs-widgets-grid">{offered.map((concept, index) => <article key={concept.id}><span aria-hidden="true">{String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}</span><p className="cs-component-kind">widget</p><h3><a href={`?path=/story/${concept.storyId}`}>{concept.label}</a></h3><p>{concept.summary}</p><footer>{concept.exports.map((item) => <code key={item.name}>{item.name}</code>)}</footer></article>)}</div>

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import manifest from "../../../../ref/design/brand/generated/manifest.json";
import { referencePath } from "../reference-path";

type Background = "light" | "dark" | "transparent";
type ImageState = "present" | "delayed" | "blocked";

const assets = [
  { id: "Creator Signal horizontal", base: "creator-signal-logo-horizontal" },
  { id: "Creator Signal stacked", base: "creator-signal-logo-stacked" },
  { id: "Sales Pulse endorsement", base: "sales-pulse-by-creator-signal-horizontal" },
  { id: "Sales Pulse mark", base: "sales-pulse-mark" }
] as const;

function variantFor(background: Background) {
  if (background === "dark") return "reversed";
  if (background === "transparent") return "one-colour";
  return "light-background";
}

function BrandAssetGallery({ background, imageState }: { background: Background; imageState: ImageState }) {
  const variant = variantFor(background);
  return (
    <main className="cs-story-shell">
      <p className="cs-story-eyebrow">Brand assets · governed output #{manifest.issue}</p>
      <h1 className="cs-story-title">Approved identities, rendered from the generated pipeline</h1>
      <p className="cs-story-lede">
        This gallery loads generated delivery assets, not copied Storybook artwork. The manifest currently governs {manifest.outputs.length} technical outputs. Admin and Content use the Creator Signal lockup with a live-text product label.
      </p>
      <section className="cs-story-section cs-reference-grid" aria-label={`${background} background brand examples`}>
        {assets.map((asset) => (
          <article className="cs-reference-card" key={asset.base}>
            <div className="cs-reference-brand-stage" data-background={background} data-image-state={imageState}>
              <img
                alt={asset.id}
                src={referencePath(`/brand-assets/delivery/${asset.base}/${variant}.svg`)}
              />
              <span className="cs-reference-brand-fallback">{asset.id}</span>
            </div>
            <strong>{asset.id}</strong>
            <code>{asset.base}/{variant}.svg</code>
          </article>
        ))}
        <article className="cs-reference-card">
          <div className="cs-reference-brand-stage" data-background={background} data-image-state={imageState}>
            <img alt="Creator Signal" src={referencePath(`/brand-assets/delivery/creator-signal-logo-horizontal/${variant}.svg`)} />
            <span className="cs-reference-brand-fallback">Creator Signal</span>
          </div>
          <strong>Creator Signal <span aria-label="Product label">Admin</span></strong>
          <span>Generic brand lockup plus live product label</span>
        </article>
        <article className="cs-reference-card">
          <div className="cs-reference-brand-stage" data-background={background} data-image-state={imageState}>
            <img alt="Creator Signal" src={referencePath(`/brand-assets/delivery/creator-signal-logo-horizontal/${variant}.svg`)} />
            <span className="cs-reference-brand-fallback">Creator Signal</span>
          </div>
          <strong>Creator Signal <span aria-label="Product label">Content</span></strong>
          <span>Generic brand lockup plus live product label</span>
        </article>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react-vite";
import { Badge, EmptyState, ErrorState, KeyValueItem, KeyValueList, LoadingIndicator, Notice, Panel, Skeleton, Stat, StatGroup, StatusIndicator } from "@creator-signal/ui";
import { adminRegisteredCustomersMetric, proCategoryLeadRule, proNetEarningsMetric } from "@sales-pulse/analytics";
import { dashboardExplainabilityCatalogue } from "@sales-pulse/dashboard-contracts";
import catalogue from "../../../../dashboard-explainability/catalogue.json";

type DataPoint = { id: string; label: string; sourceRefs: string[]; metricRefs: string[]; ruleRefs: string[] };
type Widget = { id: string; label: string; classification: string; presentationOnly?: boolean; component: string; selector: string; api?: { endpoint: string; responseFields: string[]; responseTypes: string[] }; filters: string[]; supportedStates: string[]; dataPoints: DataPoint[] };
type Section = { id: string; label: string; selector: string; widgets: Widget[] };
type Dashboard = { id: string; label: string; classification: string; lineageConfidence: string; route: string; component: string; selector: string; sections: Section[] };
type Definition = { name: string; explanation: string; semantics: { window: string; timezone: string; freshness: string; missingData: string }; authority?: string };
type ReferenceState = "normal" | "loading" | "empty" | "warning" | "error" | "entitlement" | "stale";

const generatedCatalogue = catalogue as unknown as { dashboards: Dashboard[] };
const definitions = new Map<string, Definition>([
  ["revenue.net@1", proNetEarningsMetric],
  ["signal.category-lead@1", proCategoryLeadRule],
  ["admin.registered_users@1", adminRegisteredCustomersMetric]
]);

const sourceById = new Map(dashboardExplainabilityCatalogue.sources.map((source) => [source.id, source]));
const acquisitionBySource = new Map(dashboardExplainabilityCatalogue.acquisitionPaths.map((path) => [path.sourceRef, path]));

function pilotWidgets() {
  return generatedCatalogue.dashboards.flatMap((dashboard) => dashboard.sections.flatMap((section) => section.widgets.map((widget) => ({ dashboard, section, widget })))).filter(({ widget }) => Boolean(widget.api));
}

function stateContent(state: ReferenceState) {
  if (state === "loading") return <Panel className="cs-reference-card"><LoadingIndicator label="Loading synthetic dashboard data" /><Skeleton /><Skeleton /></Panel>;
  if (state === "empty") return <EmptyState title="No synthetic records in this period" description="The reference shows the empty state without inventing a value." />;
  if (state === "warning") return <Notice heading="Partial synthetic evidence" tone="warning"><p>One source is delayed. Labels and timestamps make the limitation explicit; colour is not the only signal.</p></Notice>;
  if (state === "error") return <ErrorState title="Synthetic source unavailable" description="No data was replaced or estimated. Try again when the source is available." />;
  if (state === "entitlement") return <Notice heading="Synthetic entitlement boundary" tone="warning"><p>This widget is unavailable until the required plan or operator permission is present.</p></Notice>;
  if (state === "stale") return <Notice heading="Synthetic stale result" tone="info"><p>This view uses an older generated timestamp and must be labelled before use.</p></Notice>;
  return <Notice heading="Synthetic populated state" tone="success"><p>Example values are invented review fixtures, never customer data.</p></Notice>;
}

function Lineage({ dashboard, widget }: { dashboard: Dashboard; widget: Widget }) {
  const point = widget.dataPoints[0]!;
  const sourceRef = point.sourceRefs[0] ?? "";
  const source = sourceById.get(sourceRef);
  const acquisition = acquisitionBySource.get(sourceRef);
  const calculation = [...point.metricRefs, ...point.ruleRefs].join(" + ") || "configuration-only presentation";
  return <div className="cs-lineage" role="img" aria-label={`${dashboard.label}, ${widget.label}: dashboard to widget to API to calculation to storage to acquisition lineage`}><strong>Generated lineage (text alternative included)</strong><ol><li>{dashboard.label}</li><li>{widget.label}</li><li>{widget.api?.endpoint ?? "No API; static configuration"}</li><li>{calculation}</li><li>{source?.location ?? point.sourceRefs.join(", ")}</li><li>{acquisition?.label ?? "Repository configuration"}</li></ol></div>;
}

function DashboardSummary({ dashboard }: { dashboard: Dashboard }) {
  const widgets = dashboard.sections.flatMap((section) => section.widgets);
  return <Panel className="cs-reference-card"><p className="cs-story-eyebrow">Generated dashboard summary</p><h2>{dashboard.label}</h2><p>{dashboard.classification === "repository_configured_upstream" ? "Presentation-only configured operator links. No unavailable upstream internals are inferred." : "Application-owned surface described by accepted manifest fields and identifiers."}</p><KeyValueList><KeyValueItem label="Stable ID" value={<code>{dashboard.id}</code>} /><KeyValueItem label="Route" value={<code>{dashboard.route}</code>} /><KeyValueItem label="Source component" value={<code>{dashboard.component}</code>} /><KeyValueItem label="Manifested widgets" value={String(widgets.length)} /></KeyValueList></Panel>;
}

function WidgetReference({ dashboard, section, widget, state = "normal" }: { dashboard: Dashboard; section: Section; widget: Widget; state?: ReferenceState }) {
  const point = widget.dataPoints[0]!;
  const sources = point.sourceRefs.map((id) => sourceById.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
  const acquisitions = point.sourceRefs.map((id) => acquisitionBySource.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
  const definitionEntries = [...point.metricRefs, ...point.ruleRefs].map((reference) => [reference, definitions.get(reference)] as const);
  return <main className="cs-story-shell"><p className="cs-story-eyebrow">Dashboard explainability · synthetic static reference</p><h1 className="cs-story-title">{widget.label}</h1><p className="cs-story-lede">{dashboard.label} / {section.label}. This page is generated from accepted dashboard manifests, metric/rule contracts and source/acquisition contracts. It never connects to a customer session or provider.</p><section className="cs-story-section"><Lineage dashboard={dashboard} widget={widget} /></section><section className="cs-story-section cs-reference-grid"><Panel className="cs-reference-card"><h2>Purpose and visible part</h2><KeyValueList><KeyValueItem label="Widget ID" value={<code>{widget.id}</code>} /><KeyValueItem label="Data point ID" value={<code>{point.id}</code>} /><KeyValueItem label="Rendered selector" value={<code>{widget.selector}</code>} /><KeyValueItem label="API fields" value={<ul className="cs-reference-code-list">{widget.api?.responseFields.map((field: string) => <li key={field}><code>{field}</code></li>)}</ul>} /></KeyValueList></Panel><Panel className="cs-reference-card"><h2>Window, freshness and caveats</h2><KeyValueList><KeyValueItem label="Filters" value={widget.filters.length ? widget.filters.join(", ") : "No user-selected filters"} /><KeyValueItem label="Supported states" value={widget.supportedStates.join(", ")} /><KeyValueItem label="Confidence" value={dashboard.lineageConfidence} /><KeyValueItem label="Caveat" value={widget.presentationOnly ? "Presentation-only configuration; no product metric is claimed." : "Synthetic examples preserve the contract and do not show customer records."} /></KeyValueList></Panel></section><section className="cs-story-section"><h2>Calculation and version</h2><div className="cs-reference-grid">{definitionEntries.map(([reference, definition]) => <Panel className="cs-reference-card" key={reference}><Badge tone={definition ? "success" : "neutral"}>{reference}</Badge><h3>{definition?.name ?? "Supporting contract"}</h3><p>{definition?.explanation ?? "This supporting reference remains explicitly named but is outside the versioned pilot definition set."}</p>{definition && <KeyValueList><KeyValueItem label="Authority" value={definition.authority ??
